info.title: KHLIM API
info.description: Shared API for the KHLIM Digital Sports Ecosystem

guardianDataConsent.description: Required when creating a managed athlete under 18. Confirms that the authenticated guardian consents to processing the minor's personal data under the referenced privacy notice.

privacyNoticeVersion.description: Privacy/personal-data notice version accepted by the guardian. Required together with guardianDataConsent for a managed athlete under 18.

message.example: Thank you for registering your interest with KHLIM Academy. Our team will follow up with you.

needsFollowUp.description: Count of NEW + CONTACTED + QUALIFIED leads requiring follow-up

expectedUpdatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of updatedAt when the record was viewed, for concurrency conflict detection

NEW.description: Count of leads in NEW status

CONTACTED.description: Count of leads in CONTACTED status

QUALIFIED.description: Count of leads in QUALIFIED status

ENROLLED.description: Count of leads in ENROLLED status

CLOSED.description: Count of leads in CLOSED status

totalLeads.description: Total authoritative database leads recorded for this campaign and period

enrolledCount.description: Current enrolled leads (leads with status ENROLLED)

observableLandingSessions.description: Observable campaign landing sessions (opt-in visitors only)

interestFormEngagement.description: Interest form engagement / views (opt-in visitors only)

clientSubmitSuccesses.description: Client-side successful submission receipts (opt-in visitors only)

dataCoverage.example: Consented sessions only (opt-in analytics; US Cloud Project 652783)
dataCoverage.description: Coverage scope and privacy boundaries of traffic data

note.example: PostHog traffic represents opted-in web sessions only; it is not a direct measure of physical QR code scans.

reason.example: Server-side PostHog query API key not configured
reason.description: Diagnostic reason when status is CONFIG_REQUIRED or ERROR

methodologyNote.example: Database records are authoritative for all confirmed registrations. PostHog traffic counts include only visitors who explicitly opted into analytics; non-consenting visitors also generate valid database leads.

content.description: Per-locale { ref, sha256 } references to approved wording

source.description: Campaign token; unsafe values are dropped

reservesPlace.description: A receipt never reserves a place

q.description: Name, guardian phone or reference code

content.description: { CONSENT_TYPE: { locale: { ref, sha256 } } } for all four types and three locales
